title: How a Water Heater Works in 60 Seconds 🚿🔥 #shorts
description:
A tank water heater drops cold water to the bottom through a dip tube, heats it with a gas burner or electric elements, and lets the hot water rise to the outlet at the top. A thermostat holds the temperature, and a sacrificial anode rod corrodes so the steel tank doesn't. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#waterheater #plumbing #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Heating water uses about *18 percent* of a typical home's energy.

steps.label: Tank
steps.text: A tank heater stores about *40 to 50 gallons* in an *insulated* steel tank.

steps.label: Dip tube
steps.text: Cold water comes in through a *dip tube* that drops it right to the *bottom*.

steps.label: Heat
steps.text: A *gas burner* or electric elements heat it, and hot water *rises* to the outlet at the top.

steps.label: Thermostat
steps.text: A *thermostat* switches the heat on and off to hold your set temperature.

steps.label: Anode
steps.text: A *sacrificial anode* rod corrodes first, so the steel tank doesn't.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Sink, heat, *rise*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
